obligations.summary: The Commission must adopt delegated acts to amend Annex III by adding or modifying high-risk AI system use-cases only when the AI system is intended for use in areas listed in Annex III and poses a risk of harm to health and safety or fundamental rights equivalent to or greater than existing Annex III systems.
exceptions: Addition or modification is not permitted unless both conditions are fulfilled: (a) intended use falls within Annex III areas, and (b) risk level is equivalent to or greater than existing listed high-risk AI systems.

obligations.summary: When assessing whether an AI system poses a risk equivalent to or greater than existing high-risk AI systems, the Commission must consider the eleven criteria specified in Article 7(2), including intended purpose, autonomy, data sensitivity, harm history, reversibility, vulnerability of affected persons, and existing Union law remedies.

The Commission must adopt delegated acts to remove AI systems from the high-risk list in Annex III only when the system no longer poses significant risks to fundamental rights, health, or safety, and the removal does not decrease the overall level of protection under Union law.
exceptions: Removal is not permitted unless both conditions are fulfilled: (a) the system no longer poses significant risks, and (b) deletion does not reduce the overall level of protection of health, safety, and fundamental rights under Union law.
